title: デビュー戦の後に・ここから！

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I did it, Mom and Dad! I gave my debut everything I've got and came out feeling super swell! Talk about a weight off my shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: And knowing that my running makes all my fans happy really does make me smile.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Maybe people still mainly like me because I'm from the countryside, but while their peepers are on me, I'm gonna make sure I make myself a runner worth watching.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: That's why I've decided to run in the Tiara tour! But first, the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies! My trainer and I are revved up and raring to go!
